label: Lists: copies, sorting and unpacking (uses input)
code:
words = input('Words: ').split()
ordered = sorted(words, key=str.lower)
alias = words
alias.append('END')
snapshot = words.copy()
words.sort()
print(ordered)
print(words)
print(snapshot)
print(alias is words, snapshot is words)
first, *rest = ordered
print(first, rest)
